sources.description: Omelet uses any eligible egg and milk; recipe comes from Queen of Sauce 28 Spring Y1 or Gus for 100g.
Tortilla uses one Corn; recipe Queen of Sauce 7 Fall Y1 or Gus 100g; occasional shop sources.
Torch starter recipe consumes one Wood and two Sap; recycling Soggy Newspaper can produce three.
Recipe egg/milk/fish ingredient categories accept multiple distinct products; candidates require live content membership.
Tea Sapling requires two Wild Seeds of any season; recipe mailed after Caroline 2-heart event.
